title: Careers in Impact
description: The Philosophy, Politics, and Economics (PPE) ecosystem is vast and complex and consists of public, private, and nonprofit sectors engaged in shaping the world around them. Each sector within this ecosystem has its own theory of change and plays a specific role in the broader impact space. As you seek to become a PPE professional, it is essential to develop a deeper understanding of this ecosystem, the different levers of influence within it, and the intra-relationship between the sectors. This course introduces you to the PPE landscape so that by learning about it and you are better equipped to find your place within it.
